results.name: Nat.bitIndices
results.docstring:
The function which maps each natural number `∑ i ∈ s, 2 ^ i` to the list of
elements of `s` in increasing order.

results.name: Nat.bits
results.source_text:
/-- `bits n` returns a list of Bools which correspond to the binary representation of n, where
the head of the list represents the least significant bit -/
def bits : ℕ → List Bool :=
  binaryRec [] fun b _ IH => b :: IH

results.name: Nat.notMem_bitIndices_self
results.source_text:
theorem notMem_bitIndices_self (n : ℕ) : n ∉ n.bitIndices :=
  fun h ↦ n.lt_two_pow_self.not_ge <| two_pow_le_of_mem_bitIndices h
